items.name: Hamburger
items.description: A classic hamburger with a juicy beef patty, lettuce, tomato, pickles, and your choice of condiments. Served on a toasted bun.

items.name: Cheeseburger
items.description: A classic burger with a juicy beef patty, a slice of cheese, lettuce, tomato, pickles, and your choice of condiments. Served on a toasted bun.

items.name: Veggie Burger
items.description: A delicious veggie burger made with a blend of vegetables and spices, topped with lettuce, tomato, pickles, and your choice of condiments. Served on a toasted bun.

items.name: Rodeo Burger
items.description: A classic hamburger with a juicy beef patty, a giant onion, lettuce, tomato, pickles, and your choice of condiments. Served on a toasted bun.

items.name: Chicken Sandwich
items.description: A crispy chicken sandwich with a breaded chicken breast, lettuce, tomato, pickles, and your choice of condiments. Served on a toasted bun.

items.name: Chicken Malibu Sandwich
items.description: A grilled chicken sandwich with a juicy chicken breast, a slice of Swiss cheese, a thin slice of ham, lettuce, tomato, pickles, and your choice of condiments. Served on a toasted bun.

items.name: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
items.description: A classic grilled cheese sandwich with melted cheese between two slices of toasted bread. Served with a side of fries.
